questions.q: Match each producer `acks` setting to what the leader does before the send counts as complete.
pairs: Nothing: the record counts as sent once it is in the socket buffer
It writes the record to its own log and answers without waiting for followers
It waits for the full set of in-sync replicas
questions.explain: `acks` sets how many acknowledgements the leader must have before a request is complete. With 0 the producer doesn't wait at all (retries have no effect); with 1 the leader answers after its own write, so the record is lost if it fails before followers copy it; with all (= -1) the leader waits for the in-sync replicas, the default and what idempotence requires.

questions.q: Put the steps of an at-least-once consumer loop in order, first to last.
items: Fetch records from the partition, starting at the consumer's position
Fetch the next records, from the saved position
questions.explain: Processing before saving the position is at-least-once: a crash after processing but before the save means the records are fetched and processed again, never lost. Saving the position first and then processing is at-most-once instead.
